Meet the Reticulated giraffe, the tallest land animal reaching 6 meters! 🦒🌍

Also known as the Somali giraffe, these giants feature unique liver-red polygonal spots. With 15,785 individuals globally in 2024, Kenya remains their primary population stronghold.
